data.message: Material between cut-outs is below configured minimum
data.remediation: Move the cut-outs apart, or shrink them, until the material between them is at least the required width.

data.message: Cut-outs are closer than configured minimum spacing
data.remediation: Move the cut-outs apart to at least the required spacing.

data.message: Cut-outs remove a large share of one area of the part, which may distort it
data.remediation: Reduce the cut-out area, or accept a risk of warping.
